messages:
Nora Kim: FYI competitor "SparkEmbed" launched a low-cost "Vectors Mini" tier this morning. Saw a couple threads from GOV pilot folks asking about it. :thinking_face:
Diego Alvarez: quick skim: smaller dimensionality, aggressive int8 quant, no private VPC option. Price point undercuts our smallest embedding SKU by ~40%.
Priya Shah: Sales flagged 3 inbound RFPs asking specifically for a low-cost embeddings option. They want an answer + rough ETA within 10 days.
Owen Lee: Engineering note: trimming dims + int8 path is doable but touches model packaging, scoring path, and storage format. Main unknown = how it interacts with existing prefix cache and nearest-neighbor indexes.
Nora Kim: Important product trade: do we replicate SparkEmbed's price tier (parity chase) or build a differentiated "Vectors Tiering" approach that preserves our enterprise guarantees?
Diego Alvarez: Proposal: two-track plan
- Track A (fast): "Mini" hosted-only tier with limited guarantees, quick alpha, lower cost
- Track B (strategic): invest in tiered indexing + private support later if Mini gets traction
No Dedicated/Private on day 1.
Priya Shah: +1. Sales will accept hosted-only if we give a firm alpha window. Also need docs and FAQ around quality expectations so we don't overpromise.
Owen Lee: Rough engineering estimate: Mini alpha ~5 weeks if we scope to hosted serving changes + quant test harness. If we extend to index format changes for similarity search, add another 4-6 weeks.
Nora Kim: Acceptance criteria for Mini alpha (suggested):
1) >=25% cost-per-query reduction vs current small embedding model
2) quality drop limited to <=5% on our representative retrieval benchmark
3) auto-fallback routing to standard model when similarity quality drops, with metrics surfaced
4) rollout + kill-switch in console for quick rollback
Diego Alvarez: Add A/B telemetry hooks to measure downstream recall in customer apps (so we can close the loop). Also add a prompt set for OOD detection.
Priya Shah: I'll draft a short outbound message for prospects: "Exploring a lower-cost embeddings tier; ETA ~5-7 weeks for alpha. Reply if you'd like early access." Keeps pressure dialed down.
Owen Lee: I'll scope infra tickets and call out index compatibility risk. Will need a decision on whether the Mini uses a separate index format or reuses current index (tradeoff: cost vs migration complexity).
Nora Kim: Decision for this thread: move forward with Track A (hosted Mini alpha only) and prepare a decision point on index format before canary. Owners: Nora = product lead, Owen = eng lead, Diego = infra + metrics, Priya = GTM. Target alpha: 5 weeks.
ops-bot: Reminder set: #product 024-06-25 "Vectors Mini alpha checkpoint" (ts:1719490000).
Priya Shah: I'll post PRD skeleton in #product tomorrow and include acceptance tests. Also will coordinate a short customer advisory call if Sales wants early feedback.
Nora Kim: Thanks all. Quick next steps: update public pricing page with a note "evaluating low-cost tier", add internal FAQ, Owen to list infra tradeoffs before EOW.
